run_seg_mustc_data: run the seg_mustc_data script to segment MUST-C dataset audio into individual WAV files
run_main_function: run the main function to extract waveforms and text from a MUST-C dataset split
create_wav_files: create individual WAV files from MUST-C dataset waveforms using soundfile
create_text_and_wav_list: create text and WAV list files from a MUST-C dataset for a given language and split
review_main_function: review the main function that iterates over MUSTC dataset samples and writes segmented audio files
